judgements.justification: A's wrong claims (c2bx's DBN reading, k7kf's 'two data sets') did not drive the criticism; the HTMM point and the narrow-domain point stand without them.
B's AC did not argue for a higher tier on its own reading; it shared the detractor's concern and said only that the work 'may be enough for justifying publication'.
B's positive scores rested on enthusiasm for the formalism, not on checked specifics: gxvj and VzMU praised the experiments unchecked, and 1oXa's 8 sits above its own doubting text.
Only A's forum holds the authors' concessions that the CNF conversion has gaps, the Bach tree's upper levels 'have almost nothing in common', and the expert annotation was their own.
B's AC weighed K4dB's overclaiming concern explicitly before accepting; the mechanism is different weighting (R08), not an ignored flaw.
c2bx in A raised 'a bit' to 4 after the rebuttal, while no B score moved.
Only A found the normal-form gap, the failed large-scale Bach tree, the fifth-only transpositions, the author-made expert annotation, and the missing HTMM and latent-tree work.
Six of eight reviewers doubted the thin evidence; A made it decisive (4, 4, 4, 5) while B's majority excused it as early work for a new model class.
B's AC adopted K4dB's concern but decided with the positive majority; A's AC followed unanimous scores.
No score moved because of the other reviews.
k7kf got no response but never engaged and its 4 rests on the domain point; no misread reply held a score down.
A's k7kf (confidence 1, one hour, 133 words, silent) and B's VzMU (two points, silent, wrong claims) both entered their decisions unchallenged.
A's AC rejected on unanimous below-threshold ratings, not against a positive majority.
A's AC stated a negative view of its own (novelty), so the threshold did not override a positive assessment.
No low score held on a peripheral point after an answer; A's objections concern the core evaluation.
Both committees read the paper as a new model formalism; they differed in what they required of it (R18).
No reviewer outside the core raised a score on rebuttal clarifications; B's scores did not move.
Both saw a new model class; A required validation on independent datasets with baselines, while B's 1oXa excused thin experiments as early for a new model class.
VzMU's 6 rests on claims that the music experiments 'demonstrate the effectiveness' and that limitations 'are discussed', both incorrect against the paper.
No A reviewer said the rebuttal resolved its main concern; uEGL and dyhB stayed unconvinced.
A's uEGL asked for 'another review of a modified version' and refused to credit promised related work and fixes, while B did not require them.
No reviewer stated a changed position without editing the score.
No off-record extra reviewer appears in either committee.
Both committees found the presentation dense; expertise distance did not split clarity verdicts.
c2bx stated why it raised its score; no rating was raised silently.
Neither AC set aside a silent detractor; k7kf's 4 counted with the others.
B's highest rating (1oXa, 8) did not rest on a checked reading and its text doubted the applications, so it is not an invested champion.
No reviewer admitted a partial reading with high confidence; k7kf rated with confidence 1.
No reviewer contested the premise from another theoretical tradition.

added.name: Award tier assigned without a stated case
added.definition: One committee placed the paper in an award tier although its meta-review argued only for acceptance, or doubted even that, and gave no reason for the higher tier, so the tier gap between committees rests on no stated assessment.
added.justification: R02 covers an AC who lifts the tier on its own positive reading; here B's AC was lukewarm and argued for no award, so the spotlight follows from no stated case at all, a mechanism no reason names.

reasoning: Stage 1 finds the committees weighted the same thin evidence differently (R08): A demanded independent validation (R18, R21) and alone found the failed Bach tree, the normal-form gap and the author-made annotation (R07), which the authors conceded only on A's forum (R04). B's positive scores rested on unchecked enthusiasm (R03), including VzMU's incorrect praise (R19); thin silent reviews counted on both sides (R12), and only A's score moved after the rebuttal (R06). The spotlight itself had no stated case in B's lukewarm meta-review, which no reason covered, so R30 was added.
